title: Targetable Mass Attacks (Library of Ruina)
description: Port of Cyaminthe's Targetable Mass Attacks (Workshop 2803192752) as host callbacks on observation gates: R3 on a speed die that holds a mass attack opens a selector for its sub-targets, one arrow after the other. For Library of Ruina 1.0.3.

launcher.label: Targetable Mass Attacks
launcher.note: Allows you to individually adjust sub-targets of Mass Attacks, activate by pressing R3 on a dice that’s using one. Original mod by [Cyaminthe’s Steam Workshop](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2803192752)

obs._comment: main build ID (first 16 bytes of the module ID, 32 hex digits) -> rows {gate, offset, word, reason}; word = the 4 bytes at offset read as a little-endian u32. Offsets are the RVAs of dump.cs (main = RVA + 0x234000 in the DmIOS file).

aeea627ddbd1214764dfef5f965e94a2.reason: BattleUnitTargetArrowManagerUI.Update entry (once a frame in a battle): x0 = the arrow manager; the R3 key, the selector's input and its per-frame checks run here
BattleManagerUI.Init entry: x0 = the BattleManagerUI, kept (a new battle starts the selector over)
BattleManagerUI.set_selectedAllyDice entry: x0 = the BattleManagerUI, kept in case Init was missed
